sqlBenchmark.scope: Synthetic SQLite query benchmark, not JDBC/decode/concurrency or TPS.

pageLocationBenchmark.scope: Synthetic SQLite location hydration SQL only, not JDBC or full operation.

benchmarkMethod: Separate copies of a private stopped-fixture SQLite database were given 200,000 additional valid transaction payloads, indexes and complete event-time contexts. Shipped alpha95 Fabric and alpha96 Fabric/NeoForge storage APIs opened their own isolated databases on a background fixture thread. Each query used five warmups and fifteen timed lookup/decode iterations. IDs/order matched for sparse/dense/global queries. No production or supplied database used.
changes: Adaptive radius/bounds probe retains existing streaming plan above 2048 returned location rows; exact and whole-world query paths retain existing selection.
Page-wide location read preserves full contexts, including unaffected other-world endpoints. Existing resource/actor/entity/time filters and ordering precede page decoding.
Fixed content-free timing counters separate transaction queue/query/delivery and item history safety checks, audit fences, persistent preparation and apply/save.
Confirmation timing excludes human wait and stops on first completed/refused/recovery-required outcome. Counts are attempts, not success receipts.
safety: Same backend lock, audit fences, persistent history guards/claims, inventory observations, exclusive ownership, live checks and actual saved completion. No additional reader connection, cache of authorization, relaxed durability or forced recovery. Probe row cap is not a hard execution-time/index-visit bound.
fixtureEngineering: Dense optional-DuckDB regression fixtures use one API-encoded valid row and bulk SQL clones of immutable payloads plus all applicable indexes, avoiding slow per-row fixture creation. Query and decoding paths remain real.
limits: Warm synthetic measurements, not production capacity or TPS. Fabric sparse median 183.95ms ->18.93ms; dense 1.06ms ->1.31ms; global1.08ms ->0.70ms. No NeoForge alpha95 baseline was measured. Savings do not remove necessary save waits. Real-client and production-pack acceptance remain open.
